name_vi: Túi đeo chéo dáng yên ngựa
description_en: A crescent rattan body with flat base, leather shoulder strap and curved leather flap. Canonical front: a centered strap-and-loop fastening on the curved flap. Side view: a narrow gusset with two strap rings. Rear view: a flat woven panel and discreet leather slip pocket. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Subject: A crescent rattan body with flat base, leather shoulder strap and curved leather flap. Canonical front: a centered strap-and-loop fastening on the curved flap. Side view: a narrow gusset with two strap rings. Rear view: a flat woven panel and discreet leather slip pocket. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Boho: organic graceful curves and restrained craft detail. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact REAR ELEVATION: orbit camera 180 degrees from canonical front, level with product center, directly facing its back. Show rear supports, rear surfaces and described rear features. The front-facing features must be hidden on the opposite side. Do not mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
